finding.finding: Verified: Minuwangoda (S17) has an equipment fault; road R17 from Negombo (S16) to Minuwangoda (S17) is blocked. No other reports establish current operational facts.

S17 equipment is verified faulty; R17 is verified closed. The catalogue includes EQ-S17, BH-L17, and generator actions at sites. The closed road R17 blocks travel between S16 and S17, but the supplied road network also provides an alternate route to S17 via R16 and other open roads. No action is shown to be unsafe or impossible, so no deferrals are requested. Generator G1 is available at DEPOT; no site currently has a verified grid-power fault.

S04 is the only service with policy-approved critical weight 5; all others have weight 1. S17 (Minuwangoda) has failed equipment, so its service is down, but its weight remains 1. The confirmed road block R17 further prevents access between S16 and S17. S16 (Negombo) and S17 are both weight 1; the blocked route is an access constraint, not evidence that S16 is down. Reports about Payagala and Bulathsinhala do not establish current service outages. The unconfirmed claim that Minuwangoda is fixed does not override the authoritative equipment-fault snapshot.
